citation.authors: Rita K, Bernardo MA, Silva ML, Brito J et al

cited_by.title: Baobab fruit: blood sugar, iron and vitamin C

record.design: Randomised controlled trial: oral glucose tolerance test with or without 250 mL baobab aqueous extract
record.finding: The rise in blood glucose (incremental area under the curve) and the peak glucose were significantly lower in the baobab group than in the control group after a glucose load. The extract had high polyphenol content.
record.note: One sitting, healthy adults, a lab-made extract; authors report no conflicts of interest.
